novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that models encode “BOTH the correct and superseded versions of a mechanism as distinguishable, linearly separable directions” whose “relative representational strength” predicts outdated scientific reasoning, making its novelty route a structured historical-theory competition mechanism and measurement rather than merely a new scientific domain. Searches using “LLM internal representations superseded scientific theories,” “outdated knowledge activation steering,” “parametric knowledge conflict linear probe,” and “scientific knowledge drift language models” identify DynamicQA (2024), Taming Knowledge Conflicts in Language Models (2025), DriftMedQA (2025), and ScienceMeter (2025) as the closest work on coexisting conflicts, outdated knowledge, and steering, but not on paired accepted-versus-refuted scientific mechanisms or a direction-strength ratio predicting legacy-theory emission. The step is a substantive multi-part adaptation and operationalization of established probing, conflict, and steering ideas—not a wholly new interpretability principle—so it exceeds a simple object substitution but remains a natural extension of knowledge-conflict research rather than a 7–8-level new core relationship.
